head.text: BAD PERF -- reads bounded by the RETURN RING, not by tCCD. Tickets allocate at admit and free only when the beat drains ~49 cycles later, so the sustained rate is DEPTH/latency: 32/49 = 0.78 col/cycle = 470.9 MB/s, which is exactly what the board measured at depth 32. Issue goes idle in bursts (alloc_ready low) even though every DRAM timer is clear. Depth 64 -> 571.3 MB/s.
